name: Chicken Malai Boti
description: Creamy Pakistani chicken malai boti marinated with thick yogurt, cream, green chillies and mild spices, then grilled until juicy with lightly charred edges.
ingredients: 750 g boneless chicken, cut into even cubes
method: Pat the chicken dry and cut it into similar-size cubes so the pieces cook at roughly the same rate.
In a bowl, mix the thick yogurt, cream, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, green chillies, cumin, black pepper, garam masala, cornflour and salt until smooth.
Coat the chicken thoroughly with the marinade, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Keep the raw chicken chilled throughout marination.
Thread the pieces onto skewers without packing them too tightly and brush the surface lightly with oil.

Cook over a hot barbecue, grill or grill pan, turning as needed for even browning, until the chicken is fully cooked through and has lightly charred edges. Do not rely on surface colour alone to judge doneness.
Rest the cooked malai boti briefly before serving with chutney, sliced onion and lemon.
